description: This Java class defines a test case for telemetry over AMQP in the Eclipse Hono project. It extends a base test class and specifies test logic for creating message consumers and the endpoint name for telemetry testing.

classes.name: TelemetryAmqpIT
classes.description: A JUnit integration test for telemetry over AMQP in Eclipse Hono, testing message consumption flow with different QoS levels.

methods.name: senderQoSTypes
methods.description: Provides a stream of ProtonQoS types (AT_LEAST_ONCE and AT_MOST_ONCE) for testing different Quality of Service levels.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry message consumer using the application's client factory, returning a Future representing the asynchronous creation process.

methods.name: getEndpointName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name used in telemetry communication, 'telemetry'.
